governance.title: Approval policy and proposals
governance.explanation: Approval is optional in both modes. Enabling it changes future writes; existing pending packages keep their state.
governance.objectRequired: Enter the command fields as a JSON object.
governance.proposalRequiredBody: Create a proposal from your saved form. Review and publication happen separately; the live configuration changes only when published.
governance.secretExplanation: Only the proposal creator can receive generated secrets, once. Save them before closing this dialog.
governance.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and save the receipt before closing.
billing.memberBudget.title: Cumulative member budget across API keys
billing.memberBudget.explanation: Credits admission budget, separate from token and accounting-cost thresholds. Zero blocks new paid reservations; unlimited removes the member cap. Settled usage and history are retained.
wallet.funds.authority: The Project wallet is the ledger. Only your subscriptions in this Project appear here; dedicated allowance depends on the selected model.
wallet.funds.chooseModel: Select a model to check dedicated allowance
wallet.funds.noPrice: This model needs an active Project authorization and current retail price before funds can be used for it.
wallet.funds.dedicatedSeparate: Dedicated buckets by model — separate from unrestricted funds
governance.self: Allow an authorized administrator to review their own proposal
wallet.funds.shared: Shared Project funds and your allowance
system.productFeatures.title: Optional features
system.productFeatures.description: Visibility controls navigation. Execution controls whether the supported module can run. Permissions and approval remain separate. Explicit choices survive mode changes.
